MLMediaGroup.doc: The MLMediaGroup class provides groupings for media objects from a single source of media, such as iTunes or Aperture. The media objects—individual files containing a piece of media such as a photo, song, or movie—are referenced by one or more groups within each media source. These groupings serve as filters, providing hierarchical structure to the collection of objects in each source.

MLMediaLibrary.doc: The MLMediaLibrary class provides an interface for accessing a collection of media objects from various sources. It serves as the initial access point of the Media Library framework.

MLMediaObject.doc: The MLMediaObject class describes a single media file, such as a photo, song, or movie. Each media object contains basic metadata including a name, media type, URL, and so on. Additional information about each object is stored in its list of attributes. For a list of possible object attribute keys, see Media Object Attribute Keys.

MLMediaSource.doc: The MLMediaSource class identifies a specific provider of media. Conceptually, a media source respresents a single app, such as iTunes or Aperture. Each media source contains multiple groups of media objects—individual files containing a piece of media such as a photo, song, or movie.

MLMediaSourceType.doc: Specifies the source type associated with a particular media source. Source type reflects the primary type of media within the source. These constants are used to specify values for MLMediaLoadSourceTypesKey in the initWithOptions: method of MLMediaLibrary.

MLMediaSourceTypeAudio.doc: Audio source type. Includes iTunes, GarageBand, and Logic.

MLMediaSourceTypeImage.doc: Image source type. Includes iPhoto, Aperture, and Photo Booth.

MLMediaSourceTypeMovie.doc: Movie source type. Includes iMovie and Final Cut Pro.

MLMediaType.doc: Specifies the media type associated with a particular media object. These constants are used to specify a media object’s mediaType attribute.

-initWithOptions:.doc: Initializes the media library based on the specified load options.

-mediaGroupForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the media group with the specified identifier.

-mediaGroupsForIdentifiers:.doc: Returns the media groups with the specified identifiers.

-mediaObjectForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the media object with the specified identifier.

-mediaObjectsForIdentifiers:.doc: Returns the media objects with the specified identifiers.

URL.doc: The location of the media group.

attributes.doc: A dictionary of attributes describing the media group.

childGroups.doc: A list of child groups contained in the media group.

identifier.doc: An identifier for the media group.

mediaLibrary.doc: A pointer to the media library instance that loaded the media group’s source.

mediaObjects.doc: A list of media objects in the media group.

mediaSourceIdentifier.doc: An identifier for the source that loaded the media group.

modificationDate.doc: The date and time when the media group was last altered.

name.doc: The name of the media group.

typeIdentifier.doc: An identifier for the media group’s type.

mediaSources.doc: Returns a dictionary of media sources by identifier.

URL.doc: The location of the media object.

artworkImage.doc: Album artwork associated with the media object.

attributes.doc: A dictionary of attributes describing the media object.

contentType.doc: The UTI associated with the media object.

fileSize.doc: The size, in bytes, of the media object.

identifier.doc: An identifier for the media object.

mediaLibrary.doc: A pointer to the media library instance that loaded the media object’s source.

mediaSourceIdentifier.doc: An identifier for the source that loaded the media object.

mediaType.doc: The media object’s type of media (image, audio, or movie).

modificationDate.doc: The date and time when the media object was last altered.

name.doc: The name of the media object.

originalURL.doc: The location of the original media object, if URL is not the original location.

thumbnailURL.doc: The location of the media object’s thumbnail image.

attributes.doc: A list of attributes describing the media source.

mediaLibrary.doc: A pointer to the media library instance that loaded this media source.

mediaSourceIdentifier.doc: A unique identifier for the media source.

rootMediaGroup.doc: The base media group in the media source that contains all other groups within the source as descendant elements.
